This analysis allows the background reintroduction rate, \(\tau\), to vary
across geographic regions without adding external travel covariates. The
gravity contribution remains fixed at the posterior medians from the authors'
released chains, while the new spatial parameters are estimated with four
independent adaptive Metropolis-Hastings chains. The resulting posterior is
therefore conditional on the original gravity fit rather than a joint refit of
every coefficient in the model.

Epidemic-duration parameters are estimated in a separate four-chain block
because the duration likelihood is independent of the likelihood for
reintroduction. The original inference used 500,000 MCMC iterations and 100
forward simulations. For a shorter reproducible run, the current settings use
`r params$chains` chains of `r format(params$mcmc_iterations, big.mark = ",")`
iterations per block, discard the first
`r format(params$burn_in, big.mark = ",")` iterations from each chain, retain
every `r params$thin`th draw, and use `r params$forward_simulations` forward
simulations for Figure 2.

# Model and computational strategy

For location \(j\), time \(t\), and five-year period \(q(t)\), the spatial
extension uses

\[
\lambda_{j,t}=S_{j,t}^{\eta}
\left\{\tau_{j,q(t)}+G_{j,t}\right\},
\qquad
\log \tau_{j,q}=\delta_q+u_{r(j)}.
\]

Here, \(G_{j,t}\) is the fitted gravity contribution from the original model.
The term \(u_{r(j)}\) is a partially pooled effect for the coordinate-derived
region containing location \(j\). Its hierarchical prior is

\[
u_1=0,\qquad u_r\sim N(0,\sigma_u^2),
\qquad \sigma_u\sim \text{Half-Normal}(0,0.75).
\]

Region 1 serves as the reference category. The sampler updates the
period/region effects and \(\log\sigma_u\) in separate adaptive blocks. Pilot
diagnostics showed that the prevaccination spatial variance concentrates near
zero, so the prevaccination block uses the equivalent non-centered form
\(u_r=\sigma_u z_r\), where \(z_r\sim N(0,1)\). The vaccination-era block uses
the centered form above because its regional effects are better identified.
The regions are reproducible clusters based on coordinates rather than
official administrative boundaries.

```{r helper-functions, echo=FALSE}
####### defining the data and plotting helpers #######
read_era <- function(repository_root, era, n_rows = NULL) {
  directory <- file.path(repository_root, "data", "formatted", era)
  read_one <- function(name) {
    x <- read.csv(file.path(directory, name), check.names = FALSE)
    if (!is.null(n_rows)) x <- x[seq_len(min(n_rows, nrow(x))), , drop = FALSE]
    x
  }
  cases <- read_one("inferred_cases_urban.csv")
  population <- read_one("inferred_pop_urban.csv")
  susceptibles <- read_one("susceptibles_urban.csv")
  coordinates <- read.csv(
    file.path(directory, "coordinates_urban.csv"), check.names = FALSE
  )
  drop <- intersect(c("Yeovil.RD", "City.of.London"), names(cases))
  keep <- !names(cases) %in% drop
  cases <- cases[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  population <- population[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  susceptibles <- susceptibles[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  coordinates <- coordinates[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  list(
    time = cases[[1]],
    cases = as.matrix(cases[, -1, drop = FALSE]),
    population = as.matrix(population[, -1, drop = FALSE]),
    susceptibles = as.matrix(susceptibles[, -1, drop = FALSE]),
    coordinates = t(as.matrix(coordinates[, -1, drop = FALSE])),
    names = names(cases)[-1]
  )
}

read_small_cities <- function(repository_root, chain_name) {
  path <- file.path(
    repository_root, "output", "mcmc inference", chain_name, "small_cities.csv"
  )
  as.character(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)[[1]])
}

read_author_parameters <- function(repository_root, chain_name, period_count,
                                   tail_n = NULL) {
  directory <- file.path(repository_root, "output", "mcmc inference", chain_name)
  get_one <- function(parameter) posterior_median(directory, parameter, tail_n)
  tau_files <- if (period_count == 1L) "tau" else c("tau", "tau_2", "tau_3", "tau_4", "tau_5")
  list(
    beta = get_one("beta_coupling"),
    alpha_1 = get_one("alpha_1"),
    alpha_2 = get_one("alpha_2"),
    rho = get_one("rho"),
    eta = get_one("eta"),
    tau = vapply(tau_files, get_one, numeric(1)),
    a = get_one("a"),
    b = get_one("b"),
    psi = get_one("psi")
  )
}

prepare_spatial_era <- function(repository_root, era_name, chain_name,
                                n_rows, period_count, n_region, seed) {
  era <- read_era(repository_root, era_name, n_rows)
  recipients <- read_small_cities(repository_root, chain_name)
  recipient_index <- match(recipients, era$names)
  if (anyNA(recipient_index)) stop("some recipient locations are absent from the formatted data")
  parameters <- read_author_parameters(
    repository_root, chain_name, period_count,
    if (chain_name == "pre_vac") 50000L else NULL
  )

  recipient_coordinates <- era$coordinates[recipient_index, , drop = FALSE]
  distance <- haversine_matrix(recipient_coordinates, era$coordinates)
  distance[distance < 1e-8] <- Inf
  gravity_signal <- distance^(-parameters$rho) %*%
    t(era$cases^parameters$alpha_1)
  gravity <- parameters$beta *
    t(era$population[, recipient_index, drop = FALSE]^parameters$alpha_2) *
    gravity_signal
  susceptibility <- t(
    pmax(era$susceptibles[, recipient_index, drop = FALSE], 1e-12)^parameters$eta
  )

  recipient_cases <- t(era$cases[, recipient_index, drop = FALSE])
  n_city <- nrow(recipient_cases)
  n_time <- ncol(recipient_cases)
  at_risk <- recipient_cases[, seq_len(n_time - 1L), drop = FALSE] == 0
  event <- at_risk & recipient_cases[, 2:n_time, drop = FALSE] > 0
  period_time <- if (period_count == 1L) {
    rep(1L, n_time - 1L)
  } else {
    period_from_time(era$time[seq_len(n_time - 1L)])
  }

  city_all <- rep(seq_len(n_city), times = n_time - 1L)
  period_all <- rep(period_time, each = n_city)
  susceptibility_all <- as.vector(susceptibility[, seq_len(n_time - 1L), drop = FALSE])
  gravity_all <- as.vector(gravity[, seq_len(n_time - 1L), drop = FALSE])
  event_all <- as.vector(event)
  at_risk_all <- as.vector(at_risk)
  included <- at_risk_all & is.finite(susceptibility_all) & is.finite(gravity_all)

  regions <- make_spatial_regions(recipient_coordinates, n_region, seed)
  list(
    era = era,
    era_name = era_name,
    recipients = recipients,
    recipient_index = recipient_index,
    recipient_coordinates = recipient_coordinates,
    recipient_cases = recipient_cases,
    parameters = parameters,
    gravity = gravity,
    susceptibility = susceptibility,
    n_city = n_city,
    n_time = n_time,
    period_count = period_count,
    period_time = period_time,
    region = regions$region,
    region_centers = regions$centers,
    city = city_all[included],
    period = period_all[included],
    susceptibility_risk = susceptibility_all[included],
    gravity_risk = gravity_all[included],
    event_risk = event_all[included]
  )
}

observed_event_summaries <- function(case_matrix) {
  n <- ncol(case_matrix)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = 6)
  colnames(out) <- c(
    "cycle_mean", "cycle_sd", "reintroductions", "zeros",
    "duration_mean", "duration_sd"
  )
  for (j in seq_len(n)) {
    x <- case_matrix[, j]
    starts <- which(x[-length(x)] == 0 & x[-1] > 0)
    ends <- which(x[-length(x)] > 0 & x[-1] == 0)
    if (length(starts) && length(ends) && ends[1] < starts[1]) ends <- ends[-1]
    k <- min(length(starts), length(ends))
    durations <- if (k) ends[seq_len(k)] - starts[seq_len(k)] + 1 else numeric()
    cycles <- diff(starts)
    out[j, ] <- c(
      if (length(cycles)) mean(cycles) else NA,
      if (length(cycles) > 1) sd(cycles) else NA,
      length(starts), sum(x == 0),
      if (length(durations)) mean(durations) else NA,
      if (length(durations) > 1) sd(durations) else NA
    )
  }
  as.data.frame(out)
}

simulate_one_absence_presence <- function(rate, average_population, a, b, psi,
                                          first_zero) {
  n_city <- nrow(rate)
  n_time <- ncol(rate)
  immune_until <- first_zero - 1L
  starts <- vector("list", n_city)
  durations <- vector("list", n_city)
  occupied <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = n_city, ncol = n_time)
  nb_mu <- a * exp(b * log(average_population))
  nb_size <- psi / log(average_population)
  for (tt in seq_len(n_time)) {
    eligible <- tt >= first_zero & tt > immune_until
    if (!any(eligible)) next
    probability <- -expm1(-pmax(rate[eligible, tt], 0))
    hit_local <- runif(sum(eligible)) < probability
    if (!any(hit_local)) next
    hit <- which(eligible)[hit_local]
    duration <- 2L + rnbinom(length(hit), mu = nb_mu[hit], size = nb_size[hit])
    duration[!is.finite(duration)] <- 2L
    for (ii in seq_along(hit)) {
      city <- hit[ii]
      dur <- as.integer(duration[ii])
      starts[[city]] <- c(starts[[city]], tt)
      durations[[city]] <- c(durations[[city]], dur)
      last <- min(n_time, tt + dur - 1L)
      if (last >= tt + 1L) occupied[city, (tt + 1L):last] <- TRUE
      immune_until[city] <- tt + dur - 1L
    }
  }
  result <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_city, ncol = 6L)
  colnames(result) <- c(
    "cycle_mean", "cycle_sd", "reintroductions", "zeros",
    "duration_mean", "duration_sd"
  )
  for (j in seq_len(n_city)) {
    cycles <- diff(starts[[j]])
    duration <- durations[[j]]
    result[j, ] <- c(
      if (length(cycles)) mean(cycles) else NA,
      if (length(cycles) > 1L) sd(cycles) else NA,
      length(starts[[j]]), n_time - sum(occupied[j, ]),
      if (length(duration)) mean(duration) else NA,
      if (length(duration) > 1L) sd(duration) else NA
    )
  }
  result
}

bin_predictive_summaries <- function(simulated, observed, average_population,
                                     upper = 90000, n_bin = 40L) {
  breaks <- seq(0, upper, length.out = n_bin + 1L)
  metrics <- dimnames(simulated)[[3]]
  rows <- vector("list", length(metrics) * n_bin)
  z <- 1L
  for (metric in metrics) {
    for (i in seq_len(n_bin)) {
      members <- which(
        average_population > breaks[i] & average_population <= breaks[i + 1L]
      )
      values <- as.vector(simulated[, members, metric, drop = FALSE])
      q <- if (length(values)) {
        quantile(values, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
      } else rep(NA_real_, 3)
      obs <- if (length(members)) median(observed[members, metric], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
      rows[[z]] <- data.frame(
        metric = metric, bin = i, population_upper = breaks[i + 1L],
        lower = q[1], median = q[2], upper = q[3], observed = obs
      )
      z <- z + 1L
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

source_attribution_spatial <- function(era, recipients, row_index,
                                       parameters, tau_city) {
  recipient_index <- match(recipients, era$names)
  recipient_coords <- era$coordinates[recipient_index, , drop = FALSE]
  distance <- haversine_matrix(recipient_coords, era$coordinates)
  distance[distance < 1e-8] <- Inf
  cases <- era$cases[row_index, , drop = FALSE]
  population <- era$population[row_index, recipient_index, drop = FALSE]
  city_rows <- vector("list", length(recipients))
  event_rows <- list()
  event_z <- 1L
  for (r in seq_along(recipients)) {
    recipient_cases <- cases[, recipient_index[r]]
    events <- if (length(recipient_cases) > 1L) {
      which(recipient_cases[-length(recipient_cases)] == 0 & recipient_cases[-1] > 0)
    } else integer()
    if (!length(events)) {
      city_rows[[r]] <- data.frame(
        city = recipients[r], n_events = 0, background = NA, gravity = NA,
        dominant_source = NA, dominant_share = NA, dominant_distance_km = NA
      )
      next
    }
    donor_incidence <- cases[events, , drop = FALSE]^parameters$alpha_1
    base <- parameters$beta * distance[r, ]^(-parameters$rho)
    gravity <- sweep(donor_incidence, 2, base, "*")
    gravity <- gravity * population[events, r]^parameters$alpha_2
    total <- tau_city[r] + rowSums(gravity)
    good <- is.finite(total) & total > 0
    gravity <- gravity[good, , drop = FALSE]
    total <- total[good]
    background <- tau_city[r] / total
    source_share <- colMeans(gravity / total)
    best <- which.max(source_share)
    city_rows[[r]] <- data.frame(
      city = recipients[r], n_events = length(total),
      background = mean(background), gravity = mean(1 - background),
      dominant_source = era$names[best], dominant_share = source_share[best],
      dominant_distance_km = distance[r, best]
    )
    event_rows[[event_z]] <- data.frame(
      city = recipients[r], time_index = row_index[events[good]],
      background = background, gravity = 1 - background
    )
    event_z <- event_z + 1L
  }
  list(
    city = do.call(rbind, city_rows),
    event = if (length(event_rows)) do.call(rbind, event_rows) else data.frame(),
    coordinates = recipient_coords
  )
}

local_moran_classes <- function(values, coords, k = 8L,
                                permutations = 499L, seed = 1186L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  good <- is.finite(values)
  out <- rep("not significant", length(values))
  if (sum(good) <= k + 2L) return(out)
  z <- as.numeric(scale(values[good]))
  distance <- haversine_matrix(coords[good, , drop = FALSE], coords[good, , drop = FALSE])
  diag(distance) <- Inf
  neighbours <- t(apply(distance, 1, order))[
    seq_len(sum(good)), seq_len(k), drop = FALSE
  ]
  observed <- vapply(seq_along(z), function(i) z[i] * mean(z[neighbours[i, ]]), numeric(1))
  p_value <- numeric(length(z))
  for (i in seq_along(z)) {
    permuted <- replicate(permutations, z[i] * mean(sample(z[-i], k, replace = FALSE)))
    p_value[i] <- (1 + sum(abs(permuted) >= abs(observed[i]))) / (permutations + 1)
  }
  local_mean <- vapply(seq_along(z), function(i) mean(z[neighbours[i, ]]), numeric(1))
  classes <- ifelse(
    p_value <= 0.05 & z > 0 & local_mean > 0, "unidentifiable hotspot",
    ifelse(p_value <= 0.05 & z < 0 & local_mean < 0, "gravity hotspot", "not significant")
  )
  out[good] <- classes
  out
}

pairwise_synchrony <- function(case_matrix, coords, max_distance = 320) {
  correlation <- suppressWarnings(cor(case_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  distance <- haversine_matrix(coords, coords)
  upper <- upper.tri(distance)
  d <- distance[upper]
  y <- correlation[upper]
  good <- is.finite(d) & is.finite(y) & d <= max_distance
  d <- d[good]
  y <- y[good]
  grid <- seq(0, max_distance, by = 5)
  fit <- try(smooth.spline(d, y, spar = 0.65), silent = TRUE)
  prediction <- if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    approx(d[order(d)], y[order(d)], xout = grid, rule = 2)$y
  } else predict(fit, grid)$y
  data.frame(distance_km = grid, synchrony = pmax(-0.05, pmin(1, prediction)))
}

make_land_outline <- function(coords, ratio = 0.12) {
  if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE) &&
      "st_concave_hull" %in% getNamespaceExports("sf")) {
    geometry <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_multipoint(coords), crs = 4326)
    outline <- sf::st_concave_hull(geometry, ratio = ratio, allow_holes = FALSE)
    xy <- sf::st_coordinates(outline)
    return(xy[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE])
  }
  hull <- chull(coords[, 1], coords[, 2])
  coords[c(hull, hull[1]), , drop = FALSE]
}

panel_label <- function(label, x = 0.01, y = 0.99) {
  usr <- par("usr")
  text(
    usr[1] + x * diff(usr[1:2]), usr[3] + y * diff(usr[3:4]),
    label, font = 2, adj = c(0, 1), xpd = NA
  )
}
```

```{r compile-likelihoods, echo=FALSE}
####### compiling the optimized likelihoods #######
Rcpp::cppFunction('
double spatial_tau_loglik(
    Rcpp::NumericVector theta,
    int period_count,
    int region_count,
    Rcpp::IntegerVector city,
    Rcpp::IntegerVector period,
    Rcpp::IntegerVector region,
    Rcpp::NumericVector susceptibility,
    Rcpp::NumericVector gravity,
    Rcpp::LogicalVector event) {
  Rcpp::NumericVector effect(region_count);
  effect[0] = 0.0;
  for (int r = 1; r < region_count; ++r) {
    effect[r] = theta[period_count + r - 1];
  }
  double out = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < city.size(); ++i) {
    const int p = period[i] - 1;
    const int r = region[city[i] - 1] - 1;
    const double tau = std::exp(theta[p] + effect[r]);
    const double lambda = susceptibility[i] * (tau + gravity[i]);
    if (!R_finite(lambda) || lambda <= 0.0) return R_NegInf;
    if (event[i]) {
      const double probability = -std::expm1(-lambda);
      if (probability <= 0.0) return R_NegInf;
      out += std::log(probability);
    } else {
      out -= lambda;
    }
  }
  return out;
}')

Rcpp::cppFunction('
double duration_loglik(
    Rcpp::NumericVector theta,
    Rcpp::NumericVector y,
    Rcpp::NumericVector population) {
  const double a = std::exp(theta[0]);
  const double b = theta[1];
  const double psi = std::exp(theta[2]);
  double out = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < y.size(); ++i) {
    const double mu = a * std::exp(b * std::log(population[i]));
    const double size = psi / std::log(population[i]);
    if (!R_finite(mu) || !R_finite(size) || mu <= 0.0 || size <= 0.0) return R_NegInf;
    out += R::dnbinom_mu(y[i], size, mu, true);
  }
  return out;
}')
```

```{r mcmc-functions, echo=FALSE}
####### defining the optimizer and adaptive mcmc #######
spatial_log_posterior <- function(theta, data) {
  period_count <- data$period_count
  region_count <- max(data$region)
  expected_length <- period_count + region_count
  if (length(theta) != expected_length || any(!is.finite(theta))) return(-Inf)
  likelihood <- spatial_tau_loglik(
    theta, period_count, region_count, data$city, data$period,
    data$region, data$susceptibility_risk, data$gravity_risk, data$event_risk
  )
  if (!is.finite(likelihood)) return(-Inf)
  effects <- theta[(period_count + 1L):(period_count + region_count - 1L)]
  log_sigma <- theta[period_count + region_count]
  sigma <- exp(log_sigma)
  prior <- sum(dnorm(theta[seq_len(period_count)], log(0.1), 2.5, log = TRUE)) +
    sum(dnorm(effects, 0, sigma, log = TRUE)) +
    dnorm(sigma, 0, 0.75, log = TRUE) + log(2) + log_sigma
  likelihood + prior
}

spatial_log_posterior_noncentered <- function(theta, data) {
  period_count <- data$period_count
  region_count <- max(data$region)
  expected_length <- period_count + region_count
  if (length(theta) != expected_length || any(!is.finite(theta))) return(-Inf)
  z <- theta[(period_count + 1L):(period_count + region_count - 1L)]
  log_sigma <- theta[period_count + region_count]
  sigma <- exp(log_sigma)
  centered_theta <- c(
    theta[seq_len(period_count)], sigma * z, log_sigma
  )
  likelihood <- spatial_tau_loglik(
    centered_theta, period_count, region_count, data$city, data$period,
    data$region, data$susceptibility_risk, data$gravity_risk, data$event_risk
  )
  if (!is.finite(likelihood)) return(-Inf)
  prior <- sum(dnorm(theta[seq_len(period_count)], log(0.1), 2.5, log = TRUE)) +
    sum(dnorm(z, 0, 1, log = TRUE)) +
    dnorm(sigma, 0, 0.75, log = TRUE) + log(2) + log_sigma
  likelihood + prior
}

extract_duration_data <- function(case_matrix, average_population) {
  y <- numeric()
  population <- numeric()
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(case_matrix))) {
    x <- case_matrix[, j]
    starts <- which(x[-length(x)] == 0 & x[-1] > 0)
    ends <- which(x[-length(x)] > 0 & x[-1] == 0)
    if (length(starts) && length(ends) && ends[1] < starts[1]) ends <- ends[-1]
    k <- min(length(starts), length(ends))
    if (!k) next
    duration_minus_two <- ends[seq_len(k)] - starts[seq_len(k)] - 1L
    good <- is.finite(duration_minus_two) & duration_minus_two >= 0
    y <- c(y, duration_minus_two[good])
    population <- c(population, rep(average_population[j], sum(good)))
  }
  list(y = y, population = population)
}

duration_log_posterior <- function(theta, data) {
  if (length(theta) != 3L || any(!is.finite(theta))) return(-Inf)
  likelihood <- duration_loglik(theta, data$y, data$population)
  if (!is.finite(likelihood)) return(-Inf)
  likelihood +
    dnorm(theta[1], log(0.03), 2.5, log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(theta[2], 0.5, 1.5, log = TRUE) +
    dnorm(theta[3], log(3), 2.5, log = TRUE)
}

stabilize_covariance <- function(hessian, minimum = 1e-8, maximum = 4) {
  covariance <- try(solve(hessian), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(covariance, "try-error") || any(!is.finite(covariance))) {
    covariance <- diag(0.05^2, nrow(hessian))
  }
  eig <- eigen((covariance + t(covariance)) / 2, symmetric = TRUE)
  eig$values <- pmin(pmax(eig$values, minimum), maximum)
  eig$vectors %*% diag(eig$values) %*% t(eig$vectors)
}

run_adaptive_chain <- function(log_posterior, initial, proposal_covariance,
                               iterations, burn_in, thin, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  dimension <- length(initial)
  current <- initial
  current_lp <- log_posterior(current)
  if (!is.finite(current_lp)) stop("chain received a non-finite initial state")
  base_chol <- chol(proposal_covariance)
  log_scale <- log(2.38 / sqrt(dimension))
  target <- if (dimension == 1L) 0.44 else 0.234
  batch_accept <- 0L
  total_accept <- 0L
  kept <- floor((iterations - burn_in) / thin)
  samples <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = kept, ncol = dimension)
  keep_index <- 0L
  for (iteration in seq_len(iterations)) {
    proposal <- current + as.numeric(rnorm(dimension) %*% base_chol) * exp(log_scale)
    proposal_lp <- log_posterior(proposal)
    accepted <- is.finite(proposal_lp) &&
      log(runif(1)) < proposal_lp - current_lp
    if (accepted) {
      current <- proposal
      current_lp <- proposal_lp
      batch_accept <- batch_accept + 1L
      total_accept <- total_accept + 1L
    }
    if (iteration <= burn_in && iteration %% 100L == 0L) {
      batch <- iteration / 100L
      log_scale <- log_scale + (batch_accept / 100 - target) / sqrt(batch)
      batch_accept <- 0L
    }
    if (iteration > burn_in && (iteration - burn_in) %% thin == 0L) {
      keep_index <- keep_index + 1L
      samples[keep_index, ] <- current
    }
  }
  list(
    samples = samples,
    acceptance = total_accept / iterations,
    final_scale = exp(log_scale)
  )
}

fit_four_chain_mcmc <- function(log_posterior, start, parameter_names,
                                iterations, burn_in, thin, chains, seed) {
  mode_fit <- optim(
    start, function(theta) -log_posterior(theta), method = "BFGS",
    control = list(maxit = 1000, reltol = 1e-10)
  )
  if (mode_fit$convergence != 0L) stop("posterior mode optimization did not converge")
  hessian <- optimHess(mode_fit$par, function(theta) -log_posterior(theta))
  proposal_covariance <- stabilize_covariance(hessian)
  initial_covariance <- proposal_covariance * 4
  initial_chol <- chol(initial_covariance)
  set.seed(seed)
  initials <- vector("list", chains)
  for (chain in seq_len(chains)) {
    candidate <- mode_fit$par + as.numeric(rnorm(length(start)) %*% initial_chol)
    attempt <- 1L
    while (!is.finite(log_posterior(candidate)) && attempt < 100L) {
      candidate <- mode_fit$par + as.numeric(rnorm(length(start)) %*% initial_chol)
      attempt <- attempt + 1L
    }
    if (!is.finite(log_posterior(candidate))) candidate <- mode_fit$par
    initials[[chain]] <- candidate
  }
  run_one <- function(chain) {
    run_adaptive_chain(
      log_posterior, initials[[chain]], proposal_covariance,
      iterations, burn_in, thin, seed + chain * 1009L
    )
  }
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix" && chains > 1L) {
    results <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(chains), run_one, mc.cores = chains)
  } else {
    results <- lapply(seq_len(chains), run_one)
  }
  samples <- lapply(results, function(x) {
    colnames(x$samples) <- parameter_names
    x$samples
  })
  list(
    mode = mode_fit$par,
    mode_log_posterior = -mode_fit$value,
    chains = samples,
    acceptance = vapply(results, `[[`, numeric(1), "acceptance"),
    final_scale = vapply(results, `[[`, numeric(1), "final_scale")
  )
}

run_spatial_chain <- function(log_posterior, initial, proposal_covariance,
                              iterations, burn_in, thin, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  dimension <- length(initial)
  effect_index <- seq_len(dimension - 1L)
  sigma_index <- dimension
  current <- initial
  current_lp <- log_posterior(current)
  if (!is.finite(current_lp)) stop("spatial chain received a non-finite initial state")
  effect_chol <- chol(proposal_covariance[effect_index, effect_index, drop = FALSE])
  sigma_sd <- max(sqrt(proposal_covariance[sigma_index, sigma_index]), 0.1)
  log_scale_effect <- log(2.38 / sqrt(length(effect_index)))
  log_scale_sigma <- 0
  target_effect <- 0.234
  target_sigma <- 0.44
  batch_effect <- batch_sigma <- 0L
  total_effect <- total_sigma <- 0L
  kept <- floor((iterations - burn_in) / thin)
  samples <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = kept, ncol = dimension)
  keep_index <- 0L
  for (iteration in seq_len(iterations)) {
    proposal <- current
    proposal[effect_index] <- current[effect_index] +
      as.numeric(rnorm(length(effect_index)) %*% effect_chol) * exp(log_scale_effect)
    proposal_lp <- log_posterior(proposal)
    accepted_effect <- is.finite(proposal_lp) && log(runif(1)) < proposal_lp - current_lp
    if (accepted_effect) {
      current <- proposal
      current_lp <- proposal_lp
      batch_effect <- batch_effect + 1L
      total_effect <- total_effect + 1L
    }

    proposal <- current
    proposal[sigma_index] <- current[sigma_index] +
      rnorm(1, sd = sigma_sd * exp(log_scale_sigma))
    proposal_lp <- log_posterior(proposal)
    accepted_sigma <- is.finite(proposal_lp) && log(runif(1)) < proposal_lp - current_lp
    if (accepted_sigma) {
      current <- proposal
      current_lp <- proposal_lp
      batch_sigma <- batch_sigma + 1L
      total_sigma <- total_sigma + 1L
    }

    if (iteration <= burn_in && iteration %% 100L == 0L) {
      batch <- iteration / 100L
      log_scale_effect <- log_scale_effect +
        (batch_effect / 100 - target_effect) / sqrt(batch)
      log_scale_sigma <- log_scale_sigma +
        (batch_sigma / 100 - target_sigma) / sqrt(batch)
      batch_effect <- batch_sigma <- 0L
    }
    if (iteration > burn_in && (iteration - burn_in) %% thin == 0L) {
      keep_index <- keep_index + 1L
      samples[keep_index, ] <- current
    }
  }
  list(
    samples = samples,
    acceptance_effect = total_effect / iterations,
    acceptance_sigma = total_sigma / iterations,
    final_scale_effect = exp(log_scale_effect),
    final_scale_sigma = exp(log_scale_sigma)
  )
}

fit_spatial_four_chain_mcmc <- function(log_posterior, start, parameter_names,
                                        iterations, burn_in, thin, chains, seed) {
  mode_fit <- optim(
    start, function(theta) -log_posterior(theta), method = "BFGS",
    control = list(maxit = 1000, reltol = 1e-10)
  )
  if (mode_fit$convergence != 0L) stop("spatial posterior mode optimization did not converge")
  hessian <- optimHess(mode_fit$par, function(theta) -log_posterior(theta))
  proposal_covariance <- stabilize_covariance(hessian)
  initial_chol <- chol(proposal_covariance * 0.0001)
  set.seed(seed)
  initials <- lapply(seq_len(chains), function(chain) {
    candidate <- mode_fit$par + as.numeric(rnorm(length(start)) %*% initial_chol)
    if (is.finite(log_posterior(candidate))) candidate else mode_fit$par
  })
  run_one <- function(chain) {
    run_spatial_chain(
      log_posterior, initials[[chain]], proposal_covariance,
      iterations, burn_in, thin, seed + chain * 1009L
    )
  }
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix" && chains > 1L) {
    results <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(chains), run_one, mc.cores = chains)
  } else {
    results <- lapply(seq_len(chains), run_one)
  }
  samples <- lapply(results, function(x) {
    colnames(x$samples) <- parameter_names
    x$samples
  })
  list(
    mode = mode_fit$par,
    mode_log_posterior = -mode_fit$value,
    chains = samples,
    acceptance_effect = vapply(results, `[[`, numeric(1), "acceptance_effect"),
    acceptance_sigma = vapply(results, `[[`, numeric(1), "acceptance_sigma")
  )
}

mcmc_diagnostics <- function(fit) {
  mcmc_list <- coda::mcmc.list(lapply(fit$chains, coda::mcmc))
  rhat <- coda::gelman.diag(
    mcmc_list, autoburnin = FALSE, multivariate = FALSE
  )$psrf[, 1]
  ess <- coda::effectiveSize(mcmc_list)
  data.frame(
    parameter = names(rhat), rhat = unname(rhat),
    effective_sample_size = unname(ess), row.names = NULL
  )
}

spatial_parameter_names <- function(data, noncentered = FALSE) {
  c(
    paste0("delta_", seq_len(data$period_count)),
    paste0(if (noncentered) "z_region_" else "u_region_", 2:max(data$region)),
    "log_sigma_region"
  )
}

tau_city_period <- function(theta, data, noncentered = FALSE) {
  period_count <- data$period_count
  region_count <- max(data$region)
  effects <- theta[(period_count + 1L):(period_count + region_count - 1L)]
  if (noncentered) effects <- exp(theta[period_count + region_count]) * effects
  effects <- c(0, effects)
  exp(outer(effects[data$region], theta[seq_len(period_count)], "+"))
}

summarize_spatial_draws <- function(fit, data, noncentered = FALSE) {
  draws <- do.call(rbind, fit$chains)
  period_count <- data$period_count
  region_count <- max(data$region)
  sigma <- exp(draws[, period_count + region_count])
  effects <- cbind(0, draws[, (period_count + 1L):(period_count + region_count - 1L), drop = FALSE])
  if (noncentered) effects[, -1] <- effects[, -1, drop = FALSE] * sigma
  tau_reference <- exp(draws[, seq_len(period_count), drop = FALSE])
  values <- cbind(tau_reference, exp(effects), sigma)
  colnames(values) <- c(
    paste0("tau_reference_period_", seq_len(period_count)),
    paste0("region_rate_ratio_", seq_len(region_count)),
    "sigma_region"
  )
  q <- t(apply(values, 2, quantile, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)))
  data.frame(
    parameter = rownames(q), lower = q[, 1], median = q[, 2],
    upper = q[, 3], row.names = NULL
  )
}
```

# Preparing both eras

Figures 2 and 3 use the prevaccination data, whereas Figure 4 uses the
vaccination-era data. The spatial hierarchy is therefore fitted separately for
the two eras.

```{r prepare-data}
####### preparing the prevaccination and vaccination era data #######
pre_data <- prepare_spatial_era(
  repository_root, "prevac", "pre_vac", n_rows = 534L,
  period_count = 1L, n_region = params$spatial_regions, seed = params$seed
)
vac_data <- prepare_spatial_era(
  repository_root, "vac", "vac", n_rows = NULL,
  period_count = 5L, n_region = params$spatial_regions, seed = params$seed
)

data_summary <- data.frame(
  era = c("prevaccination", "vaccination"),
  recipient_locations = c(pre_data$n_city, vac_data$n_city),
  at_risk_intervals = c(length(pre_data$event_risk), length(vac_data$event_risk)),
  observed_reintroductions = c(sum(pre_data$event_risk), sum(vac_data$event_risk)),
  spatial_regions = c(max(pre_data$region), max(vac_data$region))
)
knitr::kable(data_summary, digits = 0)
```

# Four-chain MCMC

```{r fit-spatial-mcmc}
####### optimizing and running the spatial tau mcmc chains #######
pre_start <- c(
  log(pre_data$parameters$tau),
  rep(0, max(pre_data$region) - 1L),
  log(0.25)
)
vac_start <- c(
  log(vac_data$parameters$tau),
  rep(0, max(vac_data$region) - 1L),
  log(0.25)
)

pre_fit <- fit_spatial_four_chain_mcmc(
  function(theta) spatial_log_posterior_noncentered(theta, pre_data),
  pre_start, spatial_parameter_names(pre_data, noncentered = TRUE),
  params$mcmc_iterations, params$burn_in, params$thin,
  params$chains, params$seed + 100L
)
vac_fit <- fit_spatial_four_chain_mcmc(
  function(theta) spatial_log_posterior(theta, vac_data),
  vac_start, spatial_parameter_names(vac_data),
  params$mcmc_iterations, params$burn_in, params$thin,
  params$chains, params$seed + 200L
)
```

```{r fit-duration-mcmc}
####### optimizing and running the epidemic duration mcmc chains #######
pre_average_population <- colMeans(
  pre_data$era$population[, pre_data$recipient_index, drop = FALSE]
)
duration_data <- extract_duration_data(
  pre_data$era$cases[, pre_data$recipient_index, drop = FALSE],
  pre_average_population
)
duration_start <- c(
  log(pre_data$parameters$a), pre_data$parameters$b,
  log(pre_data$parameters$psi)
)
duration_fit <- fit_four_chain_mcmc(
  function(theta) duration_log_posterior(theta, duration_data),
  duration_start, c("log_a", "b", "log_psi"),
  params$mcmc_iterations, params$burn_in, params$thin,
  params$chains, params$seed + 300L
)
```

# Convergence checks

```{r convergence-tables}
####### checking mcmc convergence and effective sample sizes #######
pre_diagnostics <- mcmc_diagnostics(pre_fit)
vac_diagnostics <- mcmc_diagnostics(vac_fit)
duration_diagnostics <- mcmc_diagnostics(duration_fit)
pre_diagnostics$block <- "prevaccination spatial tau"
vac_diagnostics$block <- "vaccination spatial tau"
duration_diagnostics$block <- "epidemic duration"
diagnostics <- rbind(pre_diagnostics, vac_diagnostics, duration_diagnostics)

acceptance <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    block = "prevaccination tau and region effects", chain = seq_len(params$chains),
    acceptance_rate = pre_fit$acceptance_effect
  ),
  data.frame(
    block = "prevaccination regional scale", chain = seq_len(params$chains),
    acceptance_rate = pre_fit$acceptance_sigma
  ),
  data.frame(
    block = "vaccination tau and region effects", chain = seq_len(params$chains),
    acceptance_rate = vac_fit$acceptance_effect
  ),
  data.frame(
    block = "vaccination regional scale", chain = seq_len(params$chains),
    acceptance_rate = vac_fit$acceptance_sigma
  ),
  data.frame(
    block = "epidemic duration", chain = seq_len(params$chains),
    acceptance_rate = duration_fit$acceptance
  )
)

knitr::kable(acceptance, digits = 3, caption = "MCMC acceptance rates")
knitr::kable(diagnostics, digits = 3, caption = "R-hat and effective sample size")

diagnostic_pass <- all(diagnostics$rhat < 1.05) &&
  all(diagnostics$effective_sample_size >= 400)
pre_ready <- all(pre_diagnostics$rhat < 1.05) &&
  all(pre_diagnostics$effective_sample_size >= 400)
vac_ready <- all(vac_diagnostics$rhat < 1.05) &&
  all(vac_diagnostics$effective_sample_size >= 400)
duration_ready <- all(duration_diagnostics$rhat < 1.05) &&
  all(duration_diagnostics$effective_sample_size >= 400)
if (!diagnostic_pass) {
  warning(
    "At least one block has R-hat >= 1.05 or ESS < 400. ",
    "Only blocks that pass are used for new-model figures."
  )
}
```

```{r convergence-decision}
####### deciding which posterior blocks are safe to use #######
convergence_decision <- data.frame(
  block = c(
    "prevaccination spatial tau",
    "vaccination spatial tau",
    "epidemic duration"
  ),
  converged = c(pre_ready, vac_ready, duration_ready),
  figure_use = c(
    if (pre_ready) "Figures 2 and 3" else "not used; released baseline substituted",
    if (vac_ready) "Figure 4" else "not safe to use",
    if (duration_ready) "Figure 2" else "released baseline substituted"
  )
)
knitr::kable(convergence_decision)
```

Each posterior block must satisfy both convergence thresholds before its new
parameters are used in the figures. If the prevaccination block fails, Figures
2 and 3 substitute the authors' released prevaccination background rate. This
keeps a non-converged spatial posterior out of the reconstruction and indicates
that the prevaccination data do not reliably identify regional variation in
\(\tau\) when the gravity contribution is held fixed. The vaccination-era
posterior is interpreted only when its own diagnostics pass.

```{r trace-plots, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
####### plotting representative chain traces #######
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(3.5, 4, 2.5, 1), mgp = c(2.2, 0.7, 0))
trace_panels <- list(
  list(fit = pre_fit, column = "delta_1", title = "Prevaccination delta"),
  list(fit = pre_fit, column = "log_sigma_region", title = "Prevaccination log sigma"),
  list(fit = vac_fit, column = "delta_5", title = "Vaccination-era delta 5"),
  list(fit = duration_fit, column = "log_psi", title = "Duration log psi")
)
trace_colors <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A")
for (item in trace_panels) {
  range_y <- range(vapply(item$fit$chains, function(x) range(x[, item$column]), numeric(2)))
  plot(
    item$fit$chains[[1]][, item$column], type = "l", col = trace_colors[1],
    ylim = range_y, xlab = "Retained draw", ylab = item$column,
    main = item$title, las = 1
  )
  for (chain in 2:params$chains) {
    lines(item$fit$chains[[chain]][, item$column], col = trace_colors[chain])
  }
}
```

# Figure 2: convergence-gated posterior predictive reconstruction

Each forward simulation pairs one retained spatial-\(\tau\) draw with one
retained duration draw. If the prevaccination spatial block fails its
diagnostics, the simulation uses the authors' released prevaccination
background rate instead. The duration draw still comes from the duration
chains, so Figure 2 should be interpreted only when that block also passes its
diagnostics. The gray band summarizes the number of simulations specified in
the YAML settings.

```{r calculate-figure-2}
####### calculating the method four figure two predictive summaries #######
set.seed(params$seed + 400L)
pre_draws <- do.call(rbind, pre_fit$chains)
duration_draws <- do.call(rbind, duration_fit$chains)
n_sim <- params$forward_simulations
simulated <- array(
  NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, pre_data$n_city, 6L),
  dimnames = list(
    NULL, NULL,
    c("cycle_mean", "cycle_sd", "reintroductions", "zeros", "duration_mean", "duration_sd")
  )
)
first_zero <- apply(
  pre_data$era$cases[, pre_data$recipient_index, drop = FALSE], 2,
  function(x) {
    found <- which(x == 0)
    if (length(found)) found[1] else nrow(pre_data$era$cases) + 1L
  }
)

for (simulation in seq_len(n_sim)) {
  tau_draw <- pre_draws[sample.int(nrow(pre_draws), 1), ]
  duration_draw <- duration_draws[sample.int(nrow(duration_draws), 1), ]
  tau_city <- if (pre_ready) {
    tau_city_period(tau_draw, pre_data, noncentered = TRUE)[, 1]
  } else {
    rep(pre_data$parameters$tau[1], pre_data$n_city)
  }
  rate <- pre_data$susceptibility * (
    pre_data$gravity + tau_city
  )
  simulated[simulation, , ] <- simulate_one_absence_presence(
    rate, pre_average_population,
    exp(duration_draw["log_a"]), duration_draw["b"],
    exp(duration_draw["log_psi"]), first_zero
  )
}

observed <- observed_event_summaries(
  pre_data$era$cases[, pre_data$recipient_index, drop = FALSE]
)
predictive <- bin_predictive_summaries(simulated, observed, pre_average_population)
metric_labels <- c(
  cycle_mean = "Epidemic cycles (mean)", cycle_sd = "Epidemic cycles (s.d.)",
  reintroductions = "Number of reintroductions", zeros = "Number of zeros",
  duration_mean = "Epidemic durations (mean)", duration_sd = "Epidemic durations (s.d.)"
)
metric_order <- names(metric_labels)
```

```{r plot-figure-2, fig.width=11, fig.height=6.4}
####### plotting method four figure two directly in the report #######
layout(matrix(1:6, 2, 3, byrow = TRUE))
par(mar = c(3.5, 4.2, 1.1, 0.7), mgp = c(2.3, 0.7, 0), cex.axis = 0.9, cex.lab = 0.95)
for (metric in metric_order) {
  d <- predictive[predictive$metric == metric, ]
  ylim <- range(c(0, d$upper, d$observed), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(
    d$population_upper, d$observed, type = "n",
    xlab = "Average population level", ylab = metric_labels[[metric]],
    xlim = c(0, 90000), ylim = ylim, las = 1, xaxt = "n"
  )
  axis(
    1, at = c(0, 22500, 45000, 67500, 90000),
    labels = format(c(0, 22500, 45000, 67500, 90000), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  )
  polygon(
    c(d$population_upper, rev(d$population_upper)),
    c(d$lower, rev(d$upper)), col = "#D0D2D4", border = NA
  )
  lines(d$population_upper, d$median, col = "#2C6BAA", lwd = 1.3)
  points(d$population_upper, d$observed, pch = 20, cex = 0.66)
  box()
}
```

```{r plot-figure-3, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=8.2}
polygon(land_3, col = "#F4F4F4", border = "#C7C7C7")
significant <- attrib_3$city$lisa != "not significant"
lisa_colors <- c("unidentifiable hotspot" = "#FF1A1A", "gravity hotspot" = "#AFAFAF")
points(coords_3[significant, ], pch = 15, col = lisa_colors[attrib_3$city$lisa[significant]], cex = 0.65)
named <- c(Norwich = "NOR", London = "LON", Manchester = "MAN", Liverpool = "LIV", Birmingham = "BIR", Swansea = "SWA", Cardiff = "CAR", Plymouth = "PLY")
idx <- match(names(named), pre_data$era$names)
ok <- !is.na(idx)
text(pre_data$era$coordinates[idx[ok], 1], pre_data$era$coordinates[idx[ok], 2], unname(named[ok]), cex = 0.72, pos = 3)
panel_label("b")

plot(land_3, type = "n", asp = 1, xlab = "Longitude", ylab = "Latitude", xlim = c(-6, 2), ylim = c(50, 56), las = 1)
polygon(land_3, col = "#F4F4F4", border = "#C7C7C7")
category_colors <- c(Other = "#111111", core_colors)
point_size <- 0.35 + 2.1 * attrib_3$city$dominant_share
points(coords_3, pch = 21, bg = category_colors[attrib_3$city$category], col = "#222222", cex = point_size, lwd = 0.4)
legend("topright", legend = names(category_colors), pt.bg = category_colors, pch = 21, pt.cex = 0.75, cex = 0.52, bty = "n", ncol = 2)
panel_label("c")

density_3 <- density(other_distance[is.finite(other_distance)], from = 0, to = 150, na.rm = TRUE)
plot(density_3, type = "n", xlim = c(0, 150), xlab = "Distance of spread (km)", ylab = "Density", main = "", las = 1)
polygon(c(density_3$x, rev(density_3$x)), c(density_3$y, rep(0, length(density_3$y))), col = "#888888", border = "#333333")
panel_label("d")
```

# Figure 4: vaccination-era spatial patterns

Figure 4 is separated into three plots. Panel 4c summarizes empirical
synchrony in the observed cases and does not depend on \(\tau\). The fitted
spatial background rate affects the source classifications shown in Panels 4a
and 4b.

```{r calculate-figure-4}
####### calculating the method four figure four risk classes #######
periods <- data.frame(
  label = c("1960-64", "1970-74", "1975-79", "1980-84", "1985-89", "1990-94"),
  start = c(60, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90), end = c(65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95),
  model_period = c(1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L)
)
vac_draws <- do.call(rbind, vac_fit$chains)
vac_median_theta <- apply(vac_draws, 2, median)
vac_tau_city_period <- tau_city_period(vac_median_theta, vac_data)
period_results <- vector("list", nrow(periods))
synchrony_results <- vector("list", nrow(periods))
global_4 <- data.frame(period = periods$label, gravity = NA_real_, background = NA_real_)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(periods))) {
  rows <- which(vac_data$era$time >= periods$start[i] & vac_data$era$time < periods$end[i])
  tau_city <- vac_tau_city_period[, periods$model_period[i]]
  attribution <- source_attribution_spatial(
    vac_data$era, vac_data$recipients, rows, vac_data$parameters, tau_city
  )
  attribution$city$period <- periods$label[i]
  attribution$city$dominant_class <- ifelse(
    attribution$city$gravity >= attribution$city$background, "Gravity", "Unidentifiable"
  )
  attribution$city$class_share <- pmax(attribution$city$gravity, attribution$city$background)
  period_results[[i]] <- attribution$city
  global_4$background[i] <- mean(attribution$city$dominant_class == "Unidentifiable", na.rm = TRUE)
  global_4$gravity[i] <- 1 - global_4$background[i]
  synchrony <- pairwise_synchrony(
    vac_data$era$cases[rows, , drop = FALSE], vac_data$era$coordinates
  )
  synchrony$period <- periods$label[i]
  synchrony_results[[i]] <- synchrony
}

city_4 <- do.call(rbind, period_results)
synchrony_4 <- do.call(rbind, synchrony_results)
coords_4 <- vac_data$recipient_coordinates
land_4 <- make_land_outline(vac_data$era$coordinates)
coverage <- c(0.00, 0.50, 0.50, 0.65, 0.84, 0.93)
line_colors <- c("#222222", "#E41A1C", "#FB6A4A", "#CB181D", "#969696", "#525252")
line_types <- c(1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6)
```

## Figure 4a: location-wise risk classification

```{r plot-figure-4a, fig.width=13, fig.height=5.2}
####### plotting method four figure four a #######
par(mar = c(4, 4, 2.8, 0.8), mgp = c(2.4, 0.7, 0))
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(0, 6), ylim = c(0, 1))
for (i in seq_len(6)) {
  d <- city_4[city_4$period == periods$label[i], ]
  x_offset <- i - 1
  x <- x_offset + (coords_4[, 1] + 6) / 8
  y <- (coords_4[, 2] - 50) / 6
  polygon(x_offset + (land_4[, 1] + 6) / 8, (land_4[, 2] - 50) / 6, col = "#F1F1F1", border = "#BDBDBD")
  colors <- ifelse(d$dominant_class == "Gravity", "#72C5E8", "#111111")
  points(x, y, pch = 21, bg = colors, col = colors, cex = 0.15 + 1.05 * d$class_share)
  rect(x_offset, 1, x_offset + 1, 1.08, col = "#D9D9D9", border = "#555555", xpd = NA)
  text(x_offset + 0.5, 1.04, periods$label[i], cex = 0.8, xpd = NA)
}
axis(1, at = seq(0.5, 5.5, 1), labels = rep("", 6), tick = FALSE)
mtext("Longitude", 1, line = 2.2)
mtext("Latitude", 2, line = 2.2)
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Gravity", "Unidentifiable"), pch = 21, pt.bg = c("#72C5E8", "#111111"), bty = "n", horiz = TRUE, cex = 0.9)
panel_label("a", y = 1.08)
```

```{r plot-figure-4b, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.4}
panel_label("b")
```

## Figure 4c: observed spatial synchrony

```{r plot-figure-4c, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=5.4}
####### plotting method four figure four c #######

  lines(d$distance_km, d$synchrony, col = line_colors[i], lty = line_types[i], lwd = 1.6)
}
```

# Run assessment

```{r final-assessment}
####### assessing whether this mcmc run is ready to interpret #######
assessment <- data.frame(
  criterion = c(
    "vaccination Method 4 R-hat values below 1.05",
    "vaccination Method 4 effective sample sizes at least 400",
    "duration-model R-hat values below 1.05",
    "duration-model effective sample sizes at least 400",
    "prevaccination spatial extension identified",
    "vaccination and duration acceptance rates between 0.10 and 0.60"
  ),
  passed = c(
    all(vac_diagnostics$rhat < 1.05),
    all(vac_diagnostics$effective_sample_size >= 400),
    all(duration_diagnostics$rhat < 1.05),
    all(duration_diagnostics$effective_sample_size >= 400),
    pre_ready,
    all(
      acceptance$acceptance_rate[
        grepl("vaccination|duration", acceptance$block) &
          !grepl("prevaccination", acceptance$block)
      ] > 0.10 &
      acceptance$acceptance_rate[
        grepl("vaccination|duration", acceptance$block) &
          !grepl("prevaccination", acceptance$block)
      ] < 0.60
    )
  )
)
knitr::kable(assessment)
```

The vaccination-era estimates support a substantive comparison only when the
vaccination and duration checks pass. If the prevaccination block fails,
Figures 2 and 3 use the released background-rate estimate and do not provide
evidence for regional variation in prevaccination \(\tau\). Addressing that
identifiability problem would require a joint refit of the gravity parameters
or additional information about reintroduction risk. Increasing the number of
forward simulations would reduce Monte Carlo error but would not resolve the
identifiability problem. For the final analysis, Figure 2 should use the full
simulation count, and the stability of the vaccination-era estimates and
credible intervals should be checked in a clean R session.
